# Advanced Energy Introduces GaN-Based 100 W USB PD3.0 Adapter for Type BF Medical and Industrial Applications


### Posted


November 17, 2026


**DENVER, 17 November 2026** —


[Advanced Energy Industries Inc](https://www.advancedenergy.com/en-us/) . (Nasdaq: AEIS), a global leader in highly engineered, precision power conversion, measurement, and control solutions, today launched the[SLE100SPD](https://www.advancedenergy.com/en-us/products/ac-dc-power-supply-units/external-adapters/sle/sle100/) series of 100 W AC-DC adapters for fast-charging mission-critical and regulated medical and industrial applications.


The off-the-shelf 100 W USB PD3.0 AC-DC power adaptor is GaN-based (gallium nitride), complies with U.S. Department of Energy (DoE) Level VII efficiency standards, and offers dual Means of Patient Protection (MOPP) isolation for patient-connected healthcare applications. The adapter is medical and ITE certified and supports a range of fast-charging protocols, including USB PD 3.0, QC 3.0 and PPS.


The SLE100SPD helps OEMs accelerate product development by providing a fully compliant, ready-to-deploy power solution that eliminates the cost, complexity, and time associated with designing and certifying custom power supplies.


“The SLE100SPD series provides[medical](https://www.advancedenergy.com/en-us/products/ac-dc-power-supply-units/configurable-modular-psus/medical/) and industrial OEMs with a high-power charging solution that can be integrated immediately into regulated applications,” said[Shane Callanan](https://www.advancedenergy.com/en-us/about/news/authors/shane-callanan/) , Vice President Medical Products, Advanced Energy. “By combining industry-leading efficiency with comprehensive medical certifications and BF-rated isolation, customers can reduce certification risk, simplify product development, and bring new products to market faster.”


Rated to IEC 60601-1 BF level and featuring a sub-100 µA leakage current, the SLE100SPD is ideal for a wide range of medical and[industrial](https://www.advancedenergy.com/en-us/applications/industrial/) applications where safety, power density, and reliability are critical. These include patient care monitoring, portable medical equipment, life science technologies, and instrumentation.


The adapter consumes less than 0.15 W in standby mode and delivers an MTBF exceeding 100,000 hours, providing long-term reliability in demanding applications. The SLE100 USB PD is available immediately.


Specifications and datasheets are[here](https://www.advancedenergy.com/en-us/products/ac-dc-power-supply-units/external-adapters/sle/sle100/) .
